verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a conventional REST API (e.g. POST /payment/v1/rules) where the platform generates blockchain addresses, manages conversion and settlement, and reports on-chain confirmations via webhooks, so developers do not run nodes or handle chain mechanics themselves. The evidence pack shows no language client libraries or SDKs (only a separate agent-wallet CLI) and never mentions gas handling. missing for 10: language-specific client libraries/SDKs, explicit gas/fee abstraction documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I never operate blockchain infrastructure — the platform abstracts nodes, gas, and chain mechanics behind a conventional REST API with client libraries in my language
